summary: **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** 2. Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited Urja Bhawan, Kanwali Road, Dehradun – 248001 Ms. Swapna Seshadri, Advocate, THDCIL Ms. Namrata Saraogi, Advocate, THDCIL Ms. Kaushiki, Advocate, THDCIL Ms. Rashika Swarup, Advocate, THDCIL 31.3.2029, in accordance with the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 (in short, the ‘2024 Tariff Regulations’). The Commission, vide its order dated 31.8.2025, had granted interim tariff for Unit-I from its COD till 31.3.2027 or till the determination of final tariff, whichever is earlier. However, in respect of Unit-II, THDCL was granted liberty to file a separate petition for determination of tariff from its actual COD till 31.3.2029. The relevant portion of the said order is extracted below: _“34. The interim tariff granted as above is subject to adjustment based on the determination of the final tariff of Unit-I from its COD till 31.3.2029, in terms of the provisions of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. Also, as stated earlier, the interim tariff granted for Unit-I shall remain in operation for the period till 31.3.2027 or till the determination of the final tariff, whichever is earlier._ _35. In respect of Unit-II of the generating station, which has not yet achieved COD, the Petitioner is granted liberty to file a separate petition for the determination of the tariff for the period from its actual COD till 31.3.2029, in terms of the provisions of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, and after serving copies of the same on the Respondents. The petition filing fees already paid in respect of both the units shall be adjusted accordingly.”_ filed Petition No. 9/GT/2026 on 22.12.2025, seeking the determination of tariff for the period from the COD of Unit-II (26.9.2025) and for the dedicated Transmission Line from the said Project to Aligarh sub-station from COD (26.1.2025) till 31.3.2029, in accordance with the 2024 Tariff Regulations. The Commission, in continuation of the interim tariff granted earlier for Unit-I vide order dated 31.8.2025, and based on the data available on record post commissioning of Unit-II, vide order dated 6.10.2026, granted interim tariff for the generating station, comprising Unit-I and Unit-II along with the dedicated transmission line from the Project to Aligarh sub-station, from the COD of Unit-I (26.1.2025) till 31.3.2029 or till the determination of final tariff of the generating station, whichever is earlier. Vide order dated 6.10.2026, Commission granted interim tariff for both Unit-I and Unit-II, along with the associated dedicated transmission line, from its COD till 31.3.2029, subject to adjustment based on the determination of the final tariff of the generating station. In para 39 of the said order, the Commission has observed the following: _“39. Further, since Unit-II of the generating station achieved COD on 26.9.2025, and the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking tariff for the generating station as a whole, along with the dedicated transmission line, the provisional tariff determined hereinabove subsumes the interim tariff earlier allowed vide order dated 31.8.2025 in Petition No. 475/GT/2025 (for Unit-I of the generating station along with dedicated transmission line). However, the difference between the interim annual fixed charges allowed vide said order dated 31.8.2025 and those allowed in this order shall not be recovered from the Respondents at this stage. The same shall be duly considered and adjusted at the time of final tariff determination in the present Petition, which shall be listed for hearing in due course, and a separate notice in this regard shall be issued to the parties. In the meantime, the parties are directed to complete their pleadings.”_ 4. During the hearing of this Petition on 27.10.2026, the learned counsel for THDCIL pointed out that the tariff of the entire generating station, comprising both Unit-I and UnitII, along with the associated dedicated transmission line is being considered comprehensively in Petition No. 9/GT/2026. He accordingly submitted that since the interim tariff granted vide order dated 31.8.2025 in this Petition stands subsumed in the interim tariff granted for Units I & II along with the dedicated transmission line vide order dated 6.10.2026 in Petition No. 9/GT/ 2026, nothing survives for consideration in the present Petition, and the same may be disposed of as withdrawn. 5. In view of the submissions of THDCIL and considering the fact that the interim tariff granted for both the Units I & II vide order dated 6.10.2026 in Petition No.9/GT/2026, is subject to adjustment after determination of the final tariff of the generating station for the period from its COD till 31.3.2029, in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, we find no reason to keep this petition pending. Accordingly, THDCIL is permitted to withdraw the present petition. As stated, the petition filing fees already paid in respect of both the units shall be adjusted accordingly.
title: Petition for determination of tariff of Khurja Super Thermal Power Plant (2x660 MW) for the period from COD of Unit-I i.e 26.1.2025 to 31.3.2029 and for Dedicated Transmission Line from Khurja STPP (1320 MW) to Aligarh Substation from Commercial Operation Date i.e. 26.1.2025 till 31.3.2029. THDC India Limited
